name: SlidingDoorPanels
job: Cover a photo with vertical shoji-like panels that slide apart to reveal the next image, one panel at a time in a rhythm
visitor_action: click the arrows or let it auto-advance; swipe on touch; arrow keys browse when focused
motion: panels glide apart staggered with a spring-settle ease and a soft rattle in the track on arrival; closed beat shows the photo ghosting through lit paper (reduced-motion: leaves stay parked, photos crossfade)
art_direction: Shoji at golden hour: pale cedar frames with grain and end-grain tenons, translucent washi paper with raking warm light, koshi lattice with real depth, panels riding a visible track with a soft sill shadow, cream mincho captions on a sumi scrim
provenance: original, built from a concept description
notes: 2026-11-23: quality redo (Sonnet 5.5): flat cream slabs replaced by lit washi over cedar frames, koshi lattice with cast shadows, track and sill, spring-settle cascade; not yet reviewed in the gallery (no screenshots taken). Risk: backdrop-filter on up to 10 panels. | 2026-11-23: QA nit fixes. 01 / 05 counter now sits on a scrim chip (rgba dark pill + blur + hairline ring). 2026-11-24: de-skeuomorphic pass: lattice cast shadows, washi texture (fibre, shade tooth), lantern glow and warm sheen cut back; tenon end-grain removed; panel motion kept.
